question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Prudent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unwise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Prudent"** refers to someone who acts with care and thought for the future, showing good judgment and wisdom. (विवेकी, समझदार)
 
 
• **Example:** It was prudent of her to save money for emergencies.
 
 
• **"Unwise"** is the opposite of prudent and refers to someone who lacks judgment or acts without careful thought. (अविवेकी, मूर्खतापूर्ण)
